Priya: Heads-up — Prospect Arcadia Health wants a short perf validation for their triage api: sustain 150 concurrent, 3x 45s spikes to 600. Need hosted numbers + a Dedicated delta. Can we turn around in 24h?
Evan: I can run it on staging tonight. Suggested model: rwd-7b-q4 for hosted, rwd-7b-fp16 for Dedicated.
Sam: Load shape:
- 4m linear ramp to 150
- 12m steady at 150
- 3 spikes -> 600 for 45s every 90s
- 8m cool down
Also pre-warm common prefix to populate KV cache.
Evan: Plan to use wrk with openai-like payload, log tokens_in/out per request and GPU metrics. Will run with prefix-cache on/off.
Priya: Sales needs a $/1M token estimate and a short slide comparing hosted pilot vs 1yr Dedicated commit. Include note about KMS/audit retention differences.
bench-bot: Scheduled: start=3523456800, job=arcadia-3523, duration=00:28:00. Results posted here when done. :robot_face:
Evan: Run started. Will upload CSV + p95/p99 plots to thread after completion.
